moments.text: Grey-scale infrared view looking down at a sea surface covered in small wave glints; crosshair at centre, black boxes hide the display edges.
A tiny bright speck crosses the lower part of the frame from the right edge to the left in about 4.5 s. Hard to pick out from the glints; watch in motion.
After a flash the view zooms in: flat grey water, with bracket corners around the crosshair.
A brief zoom out shows rippled water, then the view zooms back in.
Another brief zoom out to rippled water, then back to the close flat view.
The view zooms out to wide wave-covered water and stays there until the clip ends.
